units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:7:6">Y. Yoma VIII, end, 45ᶜ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="J00703"><he>יָשֹׁר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Job 33:27">Job XXXIII, 27</cite>) <he>יעשה ש׳ של אנשים וכ׳</he> let him form a line of men, and say, I have sinned &c.; (Bab. ib. 87ᵃ <he>צריך לפייסו בשלש שורות וכ׳</he> must beg his pardon in the presence of three rows of three men each).
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:2">Ber. III, 2</cite> <he>עד שלא יגיעו לש׳</he> before they reach the line (of comforters).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 19a:8">Snh. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>כשהוא עובר בש׳ וכ׳</he> when he passes in the line to comfort others; <he>וכשהוא עומד בש׳ וכ׳</he> and when he stands in the line to be comforted; Tosef. ib. IV, 1, sq.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 3:3">Kil. III, 3</cite> <he>ש׳ של ירק אחר</he> a row (in the bed) of a different kind of vegetable.
Dem. VII, 8 ש׳ החיצונה the outer row (of wine vessels); a. v. fr.—Trnsf. rule of conduct.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 93">Gen. R. s. 93</cite> <he>כהוגן וכש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00193"><he>הוֹגָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73b:8">B. Mets. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>נוהג כש׳</he> he conducts himself properly.

Snh. 105ᵇ אהבה מבטלת ש׳ של גדולה love disregards the rule of dignified conduct (causes men to do things ordinarily left to servants); שנאה מבטלת ש׳ וכ׳ so does hatred disregard &c.; Gen. R. s. 55 מקלקלת את הש׳; a. fr.—שׁוּרַת הדין the line of justice, strict law; לפנים מש׳ הדין inside the line of justice, equity, v. דִּין II.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:4">Gitt. IV, 4</cite> <he>ש׳ הדין העבד וכ׳</he> by strict law the hypothecated slave (emancipated by his owner) owes to the mortgagee nothing, but for the sake of social order, we force his second master (the mortgagee) to write a letter of emancipation &c. Mekh. Yithro, ʿAmal., s. 2 (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 18:20">Ex. XVIII, 20</cite>) <he>ואת המעשה זה ש׳ הדין … לפנים מש׳ הדין</he> ‘the deed’, that means strict law, ‘which they shall do’, that means equity; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שׁוּרוֹת</he>. Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ top <he>תלמידי … ש׳ ש׳ ככרם</he> the students at college who were arrayed in rows like (the vines in) the vineyard.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:5">Kil. IV, 5</cite> <he>שתי ש׳</he> two rows of vines. Dem. l. c. <he>עשר ש׳ וכ׳</he> ten rows of ten wine vessels each.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:15">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אב̇ … עושין לו ש׳ וכ׳</he> when the president enters (college), they must form lines for him, and he passes those which he chooses; (<cite ref="Horayot 13b:7">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>שורה אחת מכאן וכ׳</he> one line on each side). Mekh. B’shall., ʿĂmal., s. 1 <he>העומדים בש׳ המלחמה</he> who stand in the battle lines; a. fr.
